Class Crop

java.lang.Object
Crop
Direct Known Subclasses:
FoodGrain
public class Crop extends Object
Represents a generic crop in the Agriculture domain. This is the top-level base class in the Multilevel Inheritance chain.

Inheritance chain: Crop → FoodGrain → OrganicFoodGrain

Version:
1.0
Author:
Mohammed Faaris Khan
